about_the_game:
Step into the Ultimate Word Challenge
Sharpen your vocabulary, outwit an AI, and put your language skills to the test in this one-of-a-kind adult word game. Every round is a new mental workout—build, decode, and define your way to victory while immersed in stunning, hand-crafted visuals drawn from real 3D-scanned assets.

Two Thrilling Modes of Play

  • Tile-Build Rounds

    • Like other word games, but with less limits: you’re given as many tiles of a chosen letter set as you want—and one precious “blank” tile—so the possibilities are endless. Working with letters such as E, N, T, and S? Rack up words like resents, tenets, steers, teens, and stress all in a single round. Your goal: find every valid combination before time runs out.

    • With each tile you place, you’ll see lifelike 3D scans of physically modeled lettertype and high-res illustrations come to life on the board, making for a tactile, visually rich experience.

  • Definition Rounds

    • Put your dictionary knowledge to the ultimate test. We give you one real definition and three false ones spun up by a powerful Large Language Model. Your mission: spot the truth. Can you tell fact from fiction, or will the AI’s clever deceptions fool you?

    • Every round challenges you to think critically—no cheating with Google! Prove you can outsmart the algorithm, and earn bragging rights each time you confidently pick the correct meaning.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Hand-Built, Authentic Art: Every asset in the game—tiles, backgrounds, UI elements—is either 3D-scanned from real-world objects or meticulously hand-drawn, giving the game a refined, handcrafted feel.

  • Endless Replayability: With thousands of possible letter combinations and an ever-evolving pool of AI-generated distractors, each session is unique. No two games are ever the same.

  • Brain-Boosting Fun: Whether you’re a crossword veteran, a Scrabble champ, or simply someone who loves word puzzles, this game offers a fresh twist that challenges your creativity and vocabulary.

  • Can the AI Fool You?: Feel the thrill of guessing against a machine. That sense of satisfaction when you pick the true definition? Priceless.

Ready to elevate your wordplay? Dive into this sleek, sophisticated mashup of classic tile-building and AI-powered quizzes. Challenge your friends, compete on the leaderboards, and see if you have what it takes to beat both the clock and the crafty AI. It’s time to play smarter—download now and prove your word mastery!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card (DirectX 12 is recommended for better performance)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.
